figmaGotchas: A use_figma script is transactional: a throw rolls back everything it did.
Paint opacity is lost when an instance inherits a variable-bound fill. Use an opacite/* variable instead.
Instances are structurally sealed: appendChild into one throws. Override text, do not inject children.
figma.currentPage cannot be removed; switch away before deleting a page.
Variable names reject '.', so Tailwind half-steps are espace/0-5 etc.
For a wrapped horizontal auto-layout, the width is the PRIMARY axis and must be FIXED.

gotchas: Sections keep child coordinates RELATIVE: appendChild preserves x/y, so absolute position shifts by the section origin. Reset x/y after reparenting.
eval and new Function both work in the plugin sandbox — a long renderer can be parked in a TEXT node once and re-run from later calls instead of being re-sent.
figma.createNodeFromSvg imports recharts path geometry; the imported wrapper frame carries a white fill that must be cleared or the no-literals audit fails.
Applying a text style then setting fontName clears textStyleId — the Fraunces italic clause in the Accueil title is the one node on the page without a style.
